messages:
Maya: Kicking off thermalization + shadow traffic test for EdgeSight's dedicated pool. Goal: validate autoscale headroom, KV/prefix cache warm rate, and steady-state batching before go-live. Target window Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC. Ops + SRE + SE please ack availability and blockers.

Jonah: I can take 03:00-04:30 UTC. Quick Q — what are the target QPS and tokens/sec we should simulate? Any particular model variants to pin?

Priya: SE here. We'll mirror production mix but with smaller token tails. Proposed profiles: burst profile = 200 qps for 10m (simulate launch), then steady 50 qps for 90m, then 20 qps cooldown. Mirror rate = 20% to keep customer safety. We'll pin to model v1.3-quant and an int8 variant for fallback checks. Also want to validate prefix TTL and KV warm hit % after 30/60/120s.

Axel: EdgeSight here — confirmed we'll allow 20% prod mirror. Two asks: (1) capture any observed cold-start regression for the renewal review (renewal end-of-quarter), (2) make sure there's a rollback plan if latency spikes persist.

Li: Oncall — noted. I'll set autoscale min_instances=4 during the run and add a cooldown of 300s to avoid scale flapping. Also will create a temporary SLO override so we don't page on small blips.

Maya: +1. Priya — paste the loadtest command and any traffic shaping config so ops can run it as-is. Also I'll draft a 1-pager for sales about risk/mitigations.

Priya: Loadtest CLI (staging):

```
runners/loadtest --env=staging \n  --target=edgesight-shadow \n  --profiles=burst,steady \n  --burst-qps=200 --steady-qps=50 \n  --burst-duration=10m --steady-duration=90m \n  --mirror-rate=0.2 \n  --duration=2h \n  --pin-model=v1.3-quant \n  --fallback-model=v1.3-int8 \n  --metrics-endpoint=https://ops.redwood/internal/metrics \n  --annotate "thermalization-shadowtest-1812346001"
```

Priya: Traffic mix: 70% short prompts (~16 tokens), 25% medium (~64 tokens), 5% long (~256 tokens). We'll also randomize user prefixes to exercise prefix cache.

Jonah: Good. Ops checklist items:
- confirm GPU pool health and prewarm kernels (done by infra)
- ensure batching config is the one from canary (continuous batching on)
- watch: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms, GPU util < 85% sustained, queue length < 64, avg batch size >= 6.
If any metric hits red for >3min we abort.

Li: I'll push temporary autoscale override now:
```
autoscaler update --pool edgesight-dedicated --min-instances 4 --cooldown 300s --policy temporary-thermalization-override
```
Will also annotate the run in the judge so it's easy to find.

deploy-bot: autoscaler policy "temporary-thermalization-override" applied to pool edgesight-dedicated by Li at 2026-03-18T22:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

Maya: Rollback plan: if p95 > 300ms for >5min OR error-rate bump >1% absolute, we immediately: (1) pause mirror, (2) switch traffic to fallback-int8, (3) open incident channel and start warmup rollback. Recording that here so Sales can see the mitigation.

Axel: Good. For renewal note — can you include: observed warmup time to 90% prefix cache hit, any persistent latency degradation vs hosted baseline, and steps taken to remediate? Sales needs that by EOD Thurs.

Maya: Will do. I'll draft the note and link it here after the run. Li/Jonah/Priya — any other blockers?

Priya: Nothing else from SE. I'll be oncall for the whole window.

Jonah: I'll monitor infra and batching. Planning to run synthetic verification script 15m before the window to confirm baseline.

Li: I've scheduled the probe and set a temporary no-auto-shutdown lock on the pool during the test.

Maya: Thanks all — marking ops checklist done. Posting run reminder in #eng-oncall 15m before. :thumbsup:

Axel: Appreciate it. We'll standby for the report and the one-pager.

Maya: After run we'll capture: short run log, p50/p95 plots, cache-hit curve, any autoscale events, and the 1-page risk summary. I'll upload to the customer folder and ping Sales.

Jonah: Ack.

Priya: Ack.

Li: Ack.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: "thermalization-shadowtest-1812346001" in 15 minutes to #eng-oncall.
